items.title: REQUIRED: stamp SALARY_ESTIMATED from BLS OEWS when no anchors (implementation in PRs)
items.detail: Tim 2026-10-28: unanchored estimate is required so rows are not left without pay. Implementation: forge-coordination PR 101 (enrich-ats-pay blsEstimate fallback) and forge-policy PR 6 (COMPENSATION_ESTIMATION rule). When same-employer and comparable anchors yield nothing, BLS OEWS P25/median/P90 stamps a LOW-confidence range (source=BLS_OEWS). Prefer posted pay or anchored estimates when present. Counts as real pay for scoring, PAY_WORTH, and the $190k floor.
items.blocks: Nothing blocked. Reduces AI research cost on rows with no posted pay.
options: Approve and merge the two PRs
Approve rules only; hold the Action
items.action: Tim decides in chat; record ruling in asks/resolved/. Do not implement absent explicit approval.
